raw_segments.text: Yes, Helgham wouldn't budge till the girl went along with them. When Clementson and
his wife realized that she couldn't resist Helgham, they let her go. Some folks are like
that, you see. In the morning the mother regretted it and begged the father to drive down to
the Ingmar farm and get their daughter.
No, indeed, he said. I'll do nothing of the sort and what's more, I never want to set
eyes on her again unless she comes home of her own accord.
